name: Nextcloud AIO
description: Nextcloud All-in-One is the official Nextcloud deployment: one master container manages Nextcloud, database, Office, Talk and backups. This VM runs it on a Debian or Ubuntu cloud image with Docker.

notes.text: Default settings use Debian 13; Advanced settings offer other Debian/Ubuntu cloud images. The AIO master container is started by the nextcloud-aio.service first-boot unit (log: /var/log/nextcloud-aio.log); if Docker cannot be pre-installed, install-docker.service runs first. Finish the setup at https://<VM-IP>:8080; the AIO password is printed with `docker exec nextcloud-aio-mastercontainer grep password /mnt/docker-aio-config/data/configuration.json`.

Nextcloud AIO requires a domain with a valid certificate and does not work on a bare IP. Point the domain at the VM and open 80/tcp and 443/tcp, or follow the AIO local-instance guide for a LAN-only setup. For a VM that works on an IP address straight away, use the TurnKey-based nextcloud-vm instead.
If you use Cloud-init, checkout cloud-init discussion: `https://github.com/community-scripts/ProxmoxVE/discussions/272`
